features.title: Goal ladder: quarter → month → week → today
features.user_visible_behavior: Goals → This quarter: up to 3 critical goals for the 12-week quarter (the Season), each a card with this month's milestone (worked backward from the quarter target, confirm or edit), this week's actions counted from the app's own data (workouts, protein days, weigh-ins, planned sessions, hard sets, focus hours, study sessions, applications, portfolio, flashcards, money saved, good nights), a traffic light from actions only (results like weight are shown, not scored), one plain next step when behind, the week's steps placed as drafts, and a 12-week strip. 'Not now' holds the other templates (money, career, sleep) with one-tap swap; a 4th is refused. Sunday review (actions per goal, then next week's top 3 pre-filled from the ladder), monthly review (milestone hit? adjust next month), quarter recap link to the Season. One line on Today → Now. The Sunday top 3 and the morning plan (study sessions via the deadline-backwards planner) follow the ladder. No points for goals or reviews; no new pushes.
